title: Console: Suggestions list page (table + filters + skeletons + empty states)
author: Nora Ahmed
body:
Summary: Implements the Console UI for the Suggestions (beta) list page: table rendering, filters (route/model/region + type + risk), status/risk chips, loading skeletons, and empty states. This PR is gated behind the `suggestions_beta` feature flag + per-tenant allowlist (BFF gating is in PR #18674). Detail drawer is intentionally out of scope here (tracked/implemented in PR #18681). Context: This is the main entry point for customers/CS to discover Optimize recommendations and assess estimated savings/risk before taking action. The list view is designed to be read-only for beta and focuses on fast scanning and trust signals.

What’s included: (1) New route `Console > Optimize > Suggestions` wired into Console nav behind the beta flag; (2) Suggestions table with columns: Suggestion, Applies to (scope summary), Est. savings, Risk, Status, Updated; (3) Filters: search (matches suggestion title + scope labels), Type (Batching/Caching), Risk (Low/Medium/High), Status (Active/Suppressed), and Scope filters (Route/Model/Region) with multi-select; (4) Status + risk chips using design system tokens (colors + accessible labels); (5) Skeleton loaders for initial load + refetch; (6) Empty states: “No suggestions yet” (no data), “Insufficient telemetry” (API returns `reason=INSUFFICIENT_DATA`), and error state with retry; (7) URL-synced filter state so CS can share a link and reproduce the view.

Screenshots (staging): - Suggestions list (default): https://console-staging.redwoodinference.com/_screenshots/pr-18680/list-default.png - Filters open + applied chips: https://console-staging.redwoodinference.com/_screenshots/pr-18680/list-filters.png - Empty state (insufficient telemetry): https://console-staging.redwoodinference.com/_screenshots/pr-18680/empty-insufficient-telemetry.png - Empty state (no suggestions): https://console-staging.redwoodinference.com/_screenshots/pr-18680/empty-no-suggestions.png - Error state: https://console-staging.redwoodinference.com/_screenshots/pr-18680/error-retry.png

Implementation notes: Uses `@redwood/console-design-system` Table + Chip components, with a thin adapter to keep `risk_level`/`status` mapping centralized (`SuggestionBadges.tsx`). API calls go through the Console BFF client (`consoleApi.optimize.listSuggestions`) and expect the v0 list shape from suggestions-service (id/title/type/risk_level/status/updated_at + scope summary + savings display fields). We intentionally display savings as “Estimated $/1M tokens” and “Est. monthly impact” only if the API marks them as `displayable=true` (otherwise we show “—” and rely on the detail drawer later for the full explanation). Pagination is currently fixed to 25 items with client-side “Load more” disabled; cursor pagination will land with #18714.

How to test: (1) Ensure your tenant is allowlisted and `suggestions_beta=true` (see enablement doc / admin tool). (2) Navigate to Console → Optimize → Suggestions. (3) Verify table renders + skeletons on refresh. (4) Apply filters and confirm URL query params update and are preserved on reload. (5) Validate empty state copy by using a tenant without suggestion generation or by setting `X-Debug-Suggestions-Empty-Reason: INSUFFICIENT_DATA` in staging via devtools (staging only). (6) Verify accessibility: tab order on filter controls, chips have aria-labels, and table headers are announced.

Out of scope: Suggestion detail drawer; apply workflows; export; cursor pagination; per-column sorting beyond default Updated desc.

Risk: Low. UI-only changes behind feature flag; no behavioral changes when flag is off.

Follow-ups: - Cursor pagination + performance improvements for large tenants (#18714) - Copy tweaks pending final disclaimer language (#18731, docs PR #944) - Add “confidence” surfacing decision after beta feedback (tracked in PM-412 notes).
commits: console: add Suggestions route + nav gating behind suggestions_beta
console: implement SuggestionsListPage table + filter bar
console: add risk/status chips + scope summary rendering
console: add skeleton loaders + empty/error states
console: sync filter state to URL + basic unit tests
conversation: Dylan Brooks (review): Love the structure and flag gating. Two requests: (1) can we persist filter state in the URL so CS can share a link? (2) risk chip colors need to match DS tokens (medium currently looks too close to high).
Nora Ahmed (author): Added URL query syncing via filterState helpers and swapped chip variants to DS `warning/subtle` for medium and `danger/subtle` for high. Screenshots updated.

Tessa Morgan (review): Empty state copy is close, but we should avoid “no optimizations available” (sounds like a guarantee). Can we change to “No suggestions to show yet” + add subtext clarifying it may be due to limited telemetry or suppressed recommendations?

Nora Ahmed (author): Updated copy per spec: “No suggestions to show yet” + added subtext and link to docs stub (hidden behind flag). Also split insufficient telemetry into its own empty state when API returns `reason=INSUFFICIENT_DATA`.
Svetlana Orlov (review): A11y: chips need aria-labels that include the category (e.g., “Risk: High”), and filter dropdown trigger should have an explicit label for screen readers.
Nora Ahmed (author): Added aria-labels and updated FilterBar triggers; also added a quick Storybook a11y check to avoid regressions.
Leila Farouk (QA): Test request: can we add a unit test for query param roundtrip (set filters -> serialize -> parse) and a render test for the empty state branch?
Nora Ahmed (author): Added `filterState.test.ts` roundtrip coverage + a page test that stubs the query hook and asserts the empty state components render.
Chloe Martin (review): Minor: for `updated_at`, please make sure we don’t crash on null; some tenants will have older records as we backfill. Also, keep sorting stable.
Nora Ahmed (author): Guarded updated_at formatting and default to “—”; sorting now falls back to id when timestamps tie/missing.
